description: reddit: Subreddit Details. GET /v1/reddit/subreddit/details. Provide one of: subreddit, url. Get details about a subreddit. Pass a subreddit name or URL to the subreddit. Subscriber counts are not available; weekly activity counts are different metrics. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cache_max_age.description: Use a cached response this old or newer for 0 credits. If none is available, fetch live at the endpoint’s normal price.

subreddit.description: Case-sensitive subreddit name, e.g. AskReddit, not askreddit.
